{{Quote|Ultimately, Belia was betrayed and murdered by her own followers. A familiar occurrence in the histories I have read.|Hetton|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
In [[1230 BBY]] during a subset of the [[New Sith Wars]] called the [[Sictis Wars]],<ref name="NEGD" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Belia Darzu]] was '''assassinated''' by the [[Mecrosa Order]],<ref name="DBROT" /> a secret society based in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="END" /> The [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] occurred after an alliance between [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darzu and the Mecrosa had fallen apart.<ref name="DBROT" /> Despite their former connections with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the Mecrosa sought revenge against Darzu for her unwanted incursion in their [[Realspace/Legends|territory]].<ref name="END" />In addition, Darzu was betrayed by her own Sith followers, who somehow participated in her [[Death/Legends|murder]].<ref name="VADER" /> Using [[Poison/Legends|poison]], the Mecrosa ended the Dark Lord's life on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]],<ref name="END" /><ref name="NEGD" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DBROT" /> The death of Lord Darzu sabotaged her [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[technobeast]]s, the [[Metanecrons]].<ref name="END" /> The Sith were also left without a clear line of succession for a new holder of the Dark Lord mantle.<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
